schema_doc: Canonical paragraph-level corrections registry. Source of truth for all manual edits applied on top of the immutable FB2 source. Pipeline: fb2_remake.fb2 → parse → text_corrections.json → apply → remake_data.js / book_text.md.

schema_fields.field: JSON path inside the paragraph object, e.g. 'text', 'choices.label', 'choices[N].label', or external location like 'src/game_logic.js:PREFACE_TEXT'
schema_fields.original: Exact substring as it appeared in the upstream source
schema_fields.source: Audit/PR reference where the issue was identified
schema_fields.type: Optional taxonomy: ocr | typo | missing_space | gameplay_logic | disambiguation | broken_target

849_text_broken_target.comment: Параграф 1830 не существует в книге (1221 параграф). Целевой параграф для второго этажа лифта — 830.

preface_pregame_ocr.comment: OCR artifacts in hardcoded constant (not extracted from FB2). Fixed in commit d23fabc.
